name: praxflow
description: Codex packaging adapter for the portable PraxFlow Agent Skills library.

interface.shortDescription: Portable product engineering workflows for multi-repository projects
interface.longDescription: PraxFlow provides agent-neutral repository bootstrap, PDF ingestion, system discovery, specification validation, protocol validation, cross-repository interface change control, system verification, and manifest release workflows. This manifest only packages the shared skills for Codex.
defaultPrompt: Ingest the PDFs in input/ with source traceability.
Discover the system contexts and unresolved decisions.
Validate this protocol specification before implementation.
